# DatabyGagan - Gagan BP's Portfolio & Services

This is the AI representation of databygagan.com. Gagan BP is a freelance technical partner based in Bengaluru, India, specializing in n8n automation, data analytics, and full-stack web development.

## Core Services
- **n8n Workflow Automation:** Complex API integrations, lead outreach systems, and WhatsApp/Telegram AI chatbots.
- **Data Analytics:** Power BI dashboards, advanced Excel automation, and Python data visualization/machine learning models.
- **Web Development:** Modern, responsive portfolio websites, landing pages, and end-to-end web applications.

## Technical Skills
- **Languages:** Python, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, SQL.
- **Data Tools:** Power BI, Excel, Pandas, NumPy.
- **Web/Automation:** Node.js, Express, React, Bootstrap, n8n, Make.com.
- **Infrastructure:** Netlify Serverless Functions, AWS. 

## Trust & Authority
- Based in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India ("The India Advantage").
- Focuses on high-quality, transparent, and ROI-driven freelance consulting.
- Offers clear, upfront pricing models for urgent, standard, and complex builds.
